scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n api,web -c blue,green "npm run dev:api" "npm run dev:web"
scripts.dev:api: cd api && set -a && { [ ! -f .env ] || . ./.env; } && set +a && go run ./cmd/server
scripts.build: npm --prefix web run build && cd api && go build -o bin/server ./cmd/server
scripts.migrate: cd api && set -a && { [ ! -f .env ] || . ./.env; } && set +a && go run ./cmd/migrate
